_comment: Example of the pm_weekly section of config.json. Setup (references/setup.md) writes it. Every value is a placeholder. Don't commit a real config to a shared repo.

features._comment: source: tracker (auto_detect re-queries each run) or list (static names/links).

output._comment: mode: markdown (default) or tracker. markdown_folder is optional; set it to share updates with product-lead-weekly-update.

schedule._comment: Standalone only. Under the `daily-digest` conductor the update day lives in the conductor's cadence (weekly-<day>) and this section is not used. If no day is set, the last working day of the week is the default.

style._comment: mode: match_prior, short_bullets, narrative, or hybrid. fallback_style applies when there are fewer than 2 prior updates.

review_step._comment: Tracker mode only. notify: chat (tell the user in chat), slack_dm (chat plus a Slack DM to user.slack_user_id), or none (enabled false). Setup Step 11 saves the value that matches the user's choice.

last_run._comment: status: delivered, published, failed, or skipped_empty_week.
